item.title: Celebrating Tony Hoare's mark on computer science
item.description:
📝 I should already note, however, for anyone not familiar with his texts, that “Hoare contribution” also connotes an unmistakable style. Thus we are permitted to prove that the procedure body possesses a property, on the assumption that every recursive call possesses that property, and then to assert categorically that every call, recursive or otherwise, has that property. To appreciate the importance of this result, one should note that the need to sort lists arises in many, probably most programs, and that the size n can be very large.
🔗 Read more: https://bertrandmeyer.com/2026/03/16/celebrating-tony-hoares-mark-on-computer-science/

item.title: Ndea (YC W26) is hiring a symbolic RL search guidance lead
item.description:
📝 Ndea is building AGI systems that depend on search guidance. We're hiring hands-on researchers/engineers to drive our deep learning effort in search guidance, training models to make structured search more efficient and reliable. com Know someone who might be a good fit for this role.

item.title: Review of Microsoft's ClearType Font Collection (2005)
item.description:
📝 These fonts will be bundled with the upcoming Longhorn operating system, scheduled to ship in late 2006. Stephen Coles asked me to review these fonts for Typographica. The version Microsoft will ship with Longhorn has two major refinements.
🔗 Read more: https://typographica.org/on-typography/microsofts-cleartype-font-collection-a-fair-and-balanced-review/
